journey.name: LC-01 Rotating the list keeps its query and sort
journey.description:
Covers NFR-06. Query and sort live in TaskListUiState inside the ViewModel, so a configuration change must not disturb them and must not re-trigger a load: the list is not re-fetched, it is recomposed.
A rotation that re-runs the initial refresh would also re-roll the dice, which is a second reason this must not happen.
Preconditions: adb shell settings put system accelerometer_rotation 0 adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0

actions.action: Tap the element with the content description "Sort tasks"
Type "e" into the "Search by title" field
Verify that "Renew domain registration" is the first row
Using adb, rotate the device to landscape
Verify that the "Search by title" field still contains "e"
Verify that "Renew domain registration" is still the first row
Verify that no "Loading" element and no "Retry" button are on screen
Using adb, rotate the device back to portrait
Verify that the "Search by title" field still contains "e"
Verify that "Renew domain registration" is still the first row
